FastingQadaa.6: Nzira uye nguva yokugadzirisa nayo mazuva okutsanya asina kuitwa, nokukurumidza kwako uye pasina mhosva.
FastingQadaa.8: AWA haibudisi fatwa kana kutonga kwechitendero kwakagadzirirwa.
FastingQadaa.10: Ndirini pandinofanira kudzorera mazuva asina kuwanikwa?
FastingQadaa.14: Qadaa inoreva kuti, munguva inotevera, mazuva ekuzvinyima zvokudya panguva yeRamadan  ⁇  kunyanya nekuda kwekusvika kwemwedzi. Mazuva aya anofanira kuitwa nekuti Ramadan kutsanya kunoramba kuri mbiru yemwedzi, uye mazuva akamiswa nekuda kwemwedzi anoverengerwa seakakodzera, pasina mhosva yako.
FastingQadaa.15: Kuumbwa kunogona kutanga pakarepo Ramadani yapera, pakarepo mamiriro ako ezvinhu anobvumira. Unogona kuronga mazuva aya panguva yako pachako: vamwe vanhu vanosarudza kuaputira pamwe chete pakarepo pashure Ramadani, apo vamwe vanovaparadzira zvishoma nezvishoma mumwedzi inotevera.
FastingQadaa.17: Kuita mazuva akatevedzana kana kuti kuapararira kunogona kuonekwa zvakasiyana zvichienderana nechikoro chemutemo; hapana nzira ipi neipi inoratidzwa pano seyo yoga inoshanda.
FastingQadaa.18: Nyora pasi mazuva ose aunofanira kuita mari yako pakarepo Ramadhan yapera
FastingQadaa.19: Sarudza nzira iri nyore: karenda, app, bhuku
FastingQadaa.21: Somuenzaniso, munhu ane mazuva 6 okuzorora anogona kusarudza kutsanya kamwe chete pavhiki kwemavhiki matanhatu, kana kuti kuapinza mumwaka mumwe chete kana zvichivaitira nyore.
FastingQadaa.22: Zvakajairika kuedza kudzorera mazuva asina kuitwa pamberi peRamadan inotevera. Kuita uku hakusi kwakanyatsomanikidzwa mumamiriro ose ezvinhu, asi kunoita kuti kuronga kuve nyore uye kunodzivisa kuunganidza nhamba huru yemazuva akamirira.
FastingQadaa.24: Kuita kuti mazuva acho ave mazhinji maererano nehurongwa hwako kunoita kuti ufambe zvakanaka, pasina kumanikidza.
FastingQadaa.25: Kuronga mberi kunobatsira kudzivisa kushushikana kwemaminitsi okupedzisira. Zano riri nyore nderokuverenga mazuva asara Ramadan inotevera isati yasvika uye kuenzanisa mazuva acho kuti awane vhiki kana kuti mwedzi.
FastingQadaa.27: Kana chikonzero chinogara chiripo kana kuti chinoitikazve chichirambidza kutsanya (chirwere chakaramba chiripo kwenguva refu, somuenzaniso), mamiriro acho ezvinhu angava pasi pomugariro wakasiyana; ipapo zvinonyanya kubatsira kukurukura nezvazvo nenyanzvi ine unyanzvi.
FastingQadaa.29: Mitemo chaiyo kana nguva yacho yakanyanyisa inogona kusiyana zvichienderana nekududzirwa.
FastingQadaa.30: Somuenzaniso, kana Ramadani inotevera ikatanga mumwedzi misere uye mazuva 6 achiri kuda kuitwa, imwe nzira ndeyokuita urongwa hwezuva rimwe chete pamwedzi, uchishanduka-shanduka pane zvisingafanoonekwi.
FastingQadaa.31: Pamuviri uye pakurera vana zvinogona kukanganisa kukwanisa kutsanya, kunyanya kana kutsanya kuchigona kukanganisa utano hwaamai kana kuti hwemwana.
FastingQadaa.33: Mamiriro ezvinhu aya anozivikanwa netsika dzechitendero seanogona kupa chikonzero chokusunungurwa.
FastingQadaa.34: Maonero ezvitendero pamusoro pekutsanya kusingaiti panguva yehupenyu hwepamuviri kana kuti kuyamwisa anogona kusiyana zvichienderana nechikoro, kunyanya panyaya yekuti kuumbwa kwakanyanya kunenge kwakakwana here kana kuti kunobatanidzwawo muripo.
FastingQadaa.36: Qadaa inokubvumira kuti unyatsogadzirisa mazuva akasiyiwa ekuzvinyima zvokudya, uchizviita zvaunoda. Kana pane mamiriro ezvinhu (kupfuura nguva, nhumbu, kuyamwisa, kutambudzwa kwenguva refu), maonero evadzidzi vanokwanisa anoramba ari chinhu chakanakisisa.
FastingQadaa.37: Kuzvinyima zvokudya uye kusunungurwa: kuumbwa (Qadaa)  ⁇  AWA

FirstPeriodComing.1: Ndinoziva sei kana nguva yangu yokutanga iri kuuya?
FirstPeriodComing.6: Zviratidzo zvishomanana zvinonyatsoratidza kuti wava nenguva yokutanga kuenda kumwedzi.
FirstPeriodComing.10: Kubuda ropa mumukadzi kana kuti ropa remwedzi?

FirstPeriodComing.17: Manzwiro maduku akadai anogona kuratidza kuti nguva yako yava pedyo.

FirstPeriodDailyLife.12: Chikoro kana kuti mabasa: chengeta bhokisi rako rine pad kana kuti tampon

FirstPeriodDailyLife.14: Kurara: pane imwe nzvimbo yakakodzera yokurara
